title: Meeting panel on the grilling agent's tab, the Open channel header switch for every agent kind, and the preparing-speech-model state
summary: The grilling agent's tab now carries the meeting panel (presence, consent, Record, Listen/Type, Use it, Skip, Jump, transcript strip, speech-model progress) and every agent tab gets a Channel switch; the session gained screen-facing IPC. Nothing starts a meeting agent yet: filed as issue #151 (Start a live meeting from Grillo).

deferred.what: The meeting panel's question card shows no ticket title, domain tags or 'Question n of m' as the prototype does, because no protocol message tells the screen which question is at hand; members can mistake which question Use it, Skip or Jump acts on.
deferred.why: Needs a new agent-to-screen protocol message (resources/skills/README.md) or a UX change first; out of this story's scope.

deferred.what: Record captures only the room microphone, because the prototype has no audio source picker, so on a remote call the other participants' voices are not transcribed.
deferred.why: Needs a UX prototype change for the source picker first.
